subject: MAP: deployment & region decision — MediQ evaluation and close cadence
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay.kumar@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: deployment & region decision — MediQ evaluation and close cadence

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our mutual action plan (attached) I wanted to lock in the evaluation track and a realistic close cadence so engineering and procurement can align. Key asks in this message:

- Confirm primary region target (EU vs US) for the PoC and GA staging run. You mentioned EU data residency as a hard requirement in certain workflows — we can support that across all modes but it materially impacts the recommended deployment lane.
- Confirm whether PHI will flow through the Redwood-managed hosted environment for the PoC or whether you prefer Dedicated/Private from day one.
- Share a single procurement point-of-contact (procurement@mediqhealth.com is fine) and any internal deadlines for signing.

Attached: MediQ_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with milestones), hosted_vs_dedicated_costs_Q4.xlsx (ballpark economics). We propose a 3-week PoC in the hosted tier (US) to validate latency/quality, with an EU-dedicated runway if you need EU residency for GA. If you need Private deployment for regulatory reasons we’ll prioritize a scoped Private proof-of-deployment and handoff timeline.

Proposed mutual milestones (high level):
1) PoC kick-off (data access + sample prompts) — week of Dec 6
2) PoC validation & cost/lantency baseline — week of Dec 13
3) Decision review (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and procurement target — Dec 21
4) Target signature and commit — by Dec 31

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call next Tuesday to go through the MAP worksheet if that helps.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: MediQ_MAP_v3.xlsx, hosted_vs_dedicated_costs_Q4.xlsx

From: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay.kumar@mediqhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@mediqhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP: deployment & region decision — MediQ evaluation and close cadence

Irene — thanks, this looks clear. A few clarifications from our side:

- For the PoC we can surface de-identified records in the EU region; however several of our workflows will require access to PHI for end-to-end validation, and our legal team prefers Private or a customer-dedicated tenancy in the EU for that.
- Procurement is looped in (procurement@mediqhealth.com). They will want an outline of terms and a SOC2 excerpt for security review.
- Timing: our Q1 rollout planning is tight, so if we can get to signature before year-end that would be ideal.

Can you confirm whether a Dedicated EU pool is available in January for an initial production-similar run? If not, we will need a Private deployment plan and cost estimate.

Thanks,
Sanjay Kumar
CTO, MediQ Health
Sanjay.Kumar@mediqhealth.com

Attachments: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: internal: recommendation for MediQ MAP (hosted/dedicated/private)

Irene/Laura/Vivek — quick internal note on tradeoffs and a recommended path to keep the deal on a year-end close while addressing Mediq's PHI concerns: 

1) Short (3-week) hosted PoC in EU-isolated region using de-identified data. This minimizes friction for initial eval and gets latency/quality metrics quickly.
2) Parallel scope: clause for a Dedicated EU pool to be provisioned in Jan (we can commit capacity if they sign a reserved capacity addendum). This satisfies residency with minimal migration overhead.
3) If Procurement/legal insist on Private for PHI, offer a fast-track Private deployment (90-day runway) priced as a professional-services + platform fee. Highlight that Private includes customer-managed VPC and HSM/KMS integration.

Notes on cost: hosted PoC cost estimate is shown in hosted_vs_dedicated_costs_Q4.xlsx; Dedicated EU baseline is ~2.1x hosted token cost (ballpark) due to reserved GPU lanes and lower shared-efficiency. Private has a one-time deployment fee and higher monthly baseline.

Recommended next actions for the MAP sheet: mark the decision milestone for Dec 21, add Procurement deliverables (SOC2 excerpt + Data Processing Agreement), and add a gated fallback (Private runbook) if Procurement requires it. I can push an updated MAP with the gating language by EOD.

Karthik
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay.kumar@mediqhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@mediqhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 14:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP: deployment & region decision — MediQ evaluation and close cadence

Thanks, Karthik and team — that approach sounds workable. Procurement asked me to forward a few items:

- Please send SOC2 evidence (we only need the security control description and auditor letter excerpt for initial review).
- Can you provide a short runbook for Private deployment (networking/VPN steps, expected lead time, and handoff checklist)?
- Please include the licensing/pricing appendix for Dedicated EU capacity so they can do the internal cost forecast.

Irene, if you can push those items (SOC2-excerpt.pdf and a brief Private-runbook summary) that will keep procurement moving. We can review and aim to have a decision by the Dec 21 checkpoint — ideally signature before Dec 31.

-Sanjay
CTO, MediQ Health

Attachments: SOC2-excerpt.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay.kumar@mediqhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: deployment & region decision — MediQ evaluation and close cadence (updated MAP + next steps)

Hi all — attaching an updated MAP that includes the procurement deliverables, the Private runbook summary, and a Dedicated EU appendix (pricing and seats). Highlights:

- We can run the PoC as EU-hosted with de-identified data starting Dec 7.
- Dedicated EU capacity can be reserved for deployment starting Jan 10 if MediQ signs a 6-month reserved capacity addendum before Dec 31.
- Private deployment option: 90-day delivery, includes VPC, KMS/HSM assist, and support-runbook.

Next steps:
1) Irene to deliver SOC2 excerpt and Private runbook (attached) — DONE.
2) Procurement to review Dedicated pricing appendix and confirm internal approval timeline.
3) Decision checkpoint meeting on Dec 21 — calendar invite to follow.

If Procurement confirms they need Private for PHI workflows we’ll kick off the 90-day runbook and produce a scoped SOW. Otherwise we’ll route to Dedicated EU for GA.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing this one out.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: MediQ_MAP_v3.xlsx, SOC2-excerpt.pdf, hosted_vs_dedicated_costs_Q4.xlsx
